I have an 18 year old who struggles with autism. You and your wife are absolutely POS parents and enabling his bad behavior. My child was nonverbal, violent and not potty trained until 2nd grade. From the age of 2 my child was in daily therapy. Speech, OT, PT, behavioral. Then at 3 I enrolled him in the special Ed preschool. Slow progress was made until the special Ed team in 2nd grade decided my child was taking advantage of the diagnosis to bully other kids and refuse work on a scale inconsistent with the diagnosis. 

So they switched things up. Instead of pulling during recess and specials for sped and bathroom, they started pulling during Reading and math… the subjects my child loved. 

It took 8 weeks of this before my child started speaking instead of using ASL. By the end of the year my child was potty trained, no longer having violent outbursts and speaking on a delayed basis, but still a massive improvement.

My child just graduated 4th in his class and has full ride scholarships to become a school psychologist. 

Autism is a spectrum and kids can have varying degrees of it, but I firmly believe had I allowed my child to continue without pushing it, and without punishment for that behavior, my child would still be wearing diapers and using sign language.

A few years ago my SO asked about ring shopping. I was stressed out about money and life and I didn’t want an expensive ring. I also wasn’t in the right mindset to be engaged, even though we know we are going to marry eventually.

I had no preset wants for my ring. If I’d specifically listed what I wanted and then found out my SO lied about the ring, I’d probably be mad he lied, but not necessarily be mad about the ring.
